nodes.label: Customer visits Retail store
nodes.desc: Customer visits Retail store for Postpaid disconnection.

nodes.label: QTicket created in Qnomy
nodes.desc: QTicket is created in Qnomy for the selected service chosen by the customer.
controls: Only one process can be initiated per transaction.

nodes.label: Agent selects next ticket in queue
nodes.desc: Retail agent shall select the next available ticket in the queue and will provide respective service to the customer.
controls: Only one process can be initiated per transaction.

nodes.label: Agent scans customer ID (IDWise)
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to scan the customer's ID using IDWise: a) Front Page, b) Back page, c) Liveliness (optional if customer agrees).

nodes.label: System validates ID type
nodes.desc: System (IDWise) shall be able to validate the ID Type and only allow: a) QID, b) Passport, c) Diplomatic ID, d) GCC ID.
controls: System (IDWise) shall validate ID Type and only allow QID, Passport, Diplomatic ID, or GCC ID.

nodes.label: Customer verification via question
nodes.desc: System shall be able to capture customer information from the scanned ID. Agent shall be able to view the customer information on UI.

nodes.label: Agent searches customer / views Customer 360
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to search the customer with MSISDN or Customer No or First Name or Last Name. System shall retrieve the customer information based on search inputs provided by agent and shall display Customer 360 View for the customer.

nodes.label: Validate disconnection request eligibility
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to create Trouble Ticket for the Retention Team with Type mentioned as Disconnection.
controls: Only account holder can make disconnection request.
Postpaid customers need to complete 3 bills lock-in period or else penalty charges will be applied.
Frontline agents are not allowed to create disconnect order directly. It has to go through trouble ticket for Retention team.
Trouble Ticket Steps from Usecase ID [referenced usecase] to be followed for ticket creation.

nodes.label: Retention ticket pushed to queue
nodes.desc: System shall push Retention ticket to Retentions team's queue.

nodes.label: Retention agent assigns & reviews ticket
nodes.desc: System shall allow Retention agent to assign ticket to himself and agent shall start working on it. Retention Agent shall check from Customer 360 View: a) Outstanding bill dues, b) Lock-ins wrt DOI and penalty charges, c) Lock-in wrt plan and respective penalty. Retention agent shall inform the customer to pay all bills and penalty charges.
controls: Retention team must attempt contact customer within SLA period — 72 hours.

nodes.label: Customer response to retention outreach?
nodes.desc: Retention agent provides retention offers to the customer (time-based discounts or time-based data add-ons) and awaits the customer's response, or attempts contact within SLA if unreachable.
controls: Retention team must attempt contact customer within SLA period — 72 hours.

nodes.label: Retention offer accepted
nodes.desc: Customer accepts Retention offer and Retention agent shall be able to create the order for adding new Add-on or adding new discount.
controls: Retention discounts are valid for a fixed period and expire automatically at the end of that period.
The same active discount cannot be applied again or overlap with another discount until the current discount has expired.

nodes.label: Add-on / discount order submitted
nodes.desc: Usecase ID "Adding Add-on" to be followed for adding discounts and add-ons and order will be submitted.

nodes.label: Dues cleared after 72hr unreachable window?
nodes.desc: Retention agent shall attempt reaching the customer contact. If no response received within 72 hours and if all customer's dues are cleared then Disconnection order will be placed. If dues are not cleared then Trouble ticket is closed and disconnection is cancelled.
controls: Retention team must attempt contact customer within SLA period — 72 hours.

nodes.label: Disconnection order placed (unreachable, dues cleared)
nodes.desc: If no response received within 72 hours and all customer's dues are cleared, Disconnection order will be placed.

nodes.label: Retention offer rejected
nodes.desc: If Customer rejects the retention offer then Agent records the outcome and asks customer to clear the outstanding bills and lock-in penalties.

nodes.label: Customer agrees to Postpaid-to-Prepaid migration?
nodes.desc: Agent shall offer migration from Postpaid to Prepaid. If customer agrees then Steps from Usecase ID "MOB_POST_TO_PRE_RETL_001" to be followed for Post to Pre migration.
controls: Customer has completed the bill plan lock-in period.
Customer is not subscribed to an active device installment plan.
All outstanding bills have been cleared.
Customer has completed star number lock-in period.

nodes.label: Post-to-Prepaid migration usecase invoked
nodes.desc: Steps from Usecase ID "MOB_POST_TO_PRE_RETL_001" to be followed for Post to Pre migration.

nodes.label: Retention agent places disconnection order
nodes.desc: If Customer doesn't agree for Post to Pre then Retention agent will place the disconnection order.
controls: Customer has completed the plan lock-in period.
Customer is not subscribed to an active device installment plan.
All outstanding bills have been cleared.

nodes.label: Complete Service Disconnection
nodes.desc: Customer requests complete disconnection for all the MSISDNs under the billing account. Agent submits disconnection order in CRM.

nodes.label: Partial Number Disconnection
nodes.desc: Customer provides details of the MSISDN which needs to be disconnected. Agent shall be able to search for the provided MSISDN and shall submit the disconnection order for the particular MSISDN only.

nodes.label: Change billing profile & handle adjustments
nodes.desc: Agent shall change the billing profile from Postpaid to Prepaid and shall make trouble tickets for any refunds or adjustments if any.
controls: Adjustments are mainly applied when a disconnection request is processed close to the billing cycle, and the customer's plan has already renewed, requiring a refund or adjustment for the renewed charges.
Adjustments are not applied to all disconnections; only those where the bill cycle has processed before the disconnection is completed.
Overpayments or mistaken payments are handled as separate refund requests, raised via tickets and validated by the back office and finance teams.
The adjustment process is documented as part of the ticketing workflow, and the outcome is tracked until resolution.

nodes.label: Disconnection order completed
nodes.desc: Disconnection order submitted in CRM — complete or partial MSISDN disconnection, with billing profile change and any adjustments processed.

nodes.label: Non-Payment Closure — ticket closed, no disconnection
nodes.desc: Customer requested disconnection but failed to pay the dues so Agent will close the trouble ticket with the details and Disconnection order won't be placed.

n01_customer_visit.title: Customer visits Retail store
n01_customer_visit.does: Walks into a Vodafone Qatar retail store to request Postpaid disconnection.
n01_customer_visit.makes: A service request that triggers a Qnomy ticket.
n01_customer_visit.example: Customer visits Retail store for Postpaid disconnection.

n02_qticket_created.title: QTicket created in Qnomy
n02_qticket_created.does: System creates a queue ticket for the selected service.
n02_qticket_created.needs: Service selection (New Connection / MNP / TON etc.).
n02_qticket_created.makes: A queued QTicket for agent assignment.

n03_agent_selects_ticket.title: Agent selects next ticket in queue
n03_agent_selects_ticket.does: Retail agent pulls the next available ticket and begins serving the customer.
n03_agent_selects_ticket.example: Only one process can be initiated per transaction.

n04_id_capture.title: Agent scans customer ID (IDWise)
n04_id_capture.does: Agent scans the customer's ID front page, back page, and optionally captures liveliness.
n04_id_capture.example: Front Page, back page, Liveliness (optional if customer agrees).

n05_id_validation.title: System validates ID type
n05_id_validation.does: IDWise validates the scanned ID is an accepted type.
n05_id_validation.example: Only QID, Passport, Diplomatic ID, or GCC ID allowed.

n06_customer_verification.title: Customer verification via question
n06_customer_verification.does: System captures customer info from the ID; agent reviews it on screen.
n06_customer_verification.example: ID Type, ID Number, First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Nationality, ID Expiry Date.

n07_customer_search.title: Agent searches customer / views Customer 360
n07_customer_search.does: Agent looks up the customer account and reviews the Customer 360 view.
n07_customer_search.needs: MSISDN, Customer No, First Name, or Last Name.
n07_customer_search.makes: Customer 360 view rendered for the agent.
n07_customer_search.example: Search by MSISDN or Customer No.

n08_ticket_creation_validation.title: Validate disconnection request eligibility
n08_ticket_creation_validation.does: Agent checks disconnection eligibility rules before raising a Retention trouble ticket.
n08_ticket_creation_validation.needs: Account holder identity, billing lock-in status.
n08_ticket_creation_validation.example: Only account holder can make disconnection request.

n09_ticket_pushed.title: Retention ticket pushed to queue
n09_ticket_pushed.does: System routes the newly created ticket into the Retentions team queue.
n09_ticket_pushed.makes: A queued ticket visible to Retention agents.
n09_ticket_pushed.example: System shall push Retention ticket to Retentions team's queue.

n10_retention_approach.title: Retention agent assigns & reviews ticket
n10_retention_approach.does: Retention agent self-assigns the ticket and reviews the customer's bill dues and lock-ins before contacting them.
n10_retention_approach.makes: A documented contact attempt within SLA.
n10_retention_approach.example: Retention team must attempt contact customer within 72 hours.

n11_retention_offer_decision.title: Customer response to retention outreach?
n11_retention_offer_decision.does: Determines whether the customer accepts a retention offer, is unreachable, or rejects the offer.
n11_retention_offer_decision.needs: Outcome of the retention agent's outreach.
n11_retention_offer_decision.example: Offer accepted / Customer unreachable / Offer rejected.

n12_offer_accepted.title: Retention offer accepted
n12_offer_accepted.does: Customer accepts a time-based discount or data add-on offer.
n12_offer_accepted.makes: An order for the new add-on/discount.
n12_offer_accepted.example: Time based discounts or Time based Data add-ons.

n13_adding_addon.title: Add-on / discount order submitted
n13_adding_addon.does: Follows the separate Adding Add-on usecase to submit the order.
n13_adding_addon.example: Usecase ID "Adding Add-on" to be followed.

n14_customer_unreachable.title: Dues cleared after 72hr unreachable window?
n14_customer_unreachable.does: Checks whether outstanding dues were cleared after the customer could not be reached within the SLA window.
n14_customer_unreachable.needs: 72-hour contact attempt outcome; billing dues status.
n14_customer_unreachable.makes: Either a disconnection order or a closed/cancelled ticket.

n15_disconnection_placed_unreachable.title: Disconnection order placed (unreachable, dues cleared)
n15_disconnection_placed_unreachable.does: System places the disconnection order since dues are clear despite no customer response.

n16_offer_rejected.title: Retention offer rejected
n16_offer_rejected.does: Agent records that the customer declined the retention offer and asks them to clear outstanding bills/penalties.
n16_offer_rejected.example: Agent records the outcome and asks customer to clear outstanding bills.

n17_migration_offer_decision.title: Customer agrees to Postpaid-to-Prepaid migration?
n17_migration_offer_decision.does: Agent offers migration from Postpaid to Prepaid as an alternative to disconnection.
n17_migration_offer_decision.needs: Lock-in completion, cleared bills, no active device installment.
n17_migration_offer_decision.makes: Either a migration handoff or a disconnection order.

n18_migration_referenced.title: Post-to-Prepaid migration usecase invoked
n18_migration_referenced.does: Hands off to the separate Post-to-Prepaid migration usecase.
n18_migration_referenced.makes: A migration process kicked off in another usecase.

n19_disconnection_order_placed.title: Retention agent places disconnection order
n19_disconnection_order_placed.does: Retention agent proceeds with disconnection since the customer declined migration.
n19_disconnection_order_placed.needs: Cleared lock-ins and bills; no active device installment.
n19_disconnection_order_placed.example: Retention agent will place the disconnection order.

n20_complete_disconnection.title: Complete Service Disconnection
n20_complete_disconnection.does: Agent submits a disconnection order for all MSISDNs under the billing account.
n20_complete_disconnection.needs: Customer Number, Disconnect Reason, Effective Date.
n20_complete_disconnection.makes: A full-account disconnection order in CRM.
n20_complete_disconnection.example: Disconnection for all the MSISDNs under the billing account.

n21_partial_disconnection.title: Partial Number Disconnection
n21_partial_disconnection.does: Agent submits a disconnection order for a single specified MSISDN.
n21_partial_disconnection.example: Disconnection order for the particular MSISDN only.

n22_change_billing_profile.title: Change billing profile & handle adjustments
n22_change_billing_profile.does: Agent switches the billing profile from Postpaid to Prepaid and raises trouble tickets for any refund/adjustment.
n22_change_billing_profile.makes: Updated billing profile and, where applicable, a refund/adjustment ticket.
n22_change_billing_profile.example: Adjustments applied when disconnection is processed close to the billing cycle.

n23_disconnection_end.title: Disconnection order completed
n23_disconnection_end.does: Marks the end of the disconnection process once the order and any adjustments are processed.

n26_non_payment_closure.title: Non-Payment Closure — ticket closed, no disconnection
n26_non_payment_closure.does: Agent closes the trouble ticket because the customer failed to pay outstanding dues; no disconnection order is placed.
n26_non_payment_closure.makes: A closed ticket with no disconnection executed.
n26_non_payment_closure.example: Ticket ID, Outstanding Amount, Closure Reason.
